title: Marvel Super Heroes Vs. Street Fighter
note: Capcom CPS2 fighting game: health, health_p2, time, power, power_p2, 25 characters (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cps_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: CPS work RAM from 0xFF0000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

titles.mshvsfex: Marvel Super Heroes Vs. Street Fighter EX
titles.mshvsfexj: Marvel Super Heroes Vs. Street Fighter EX

power.note: super gauge of player 1 in %, full = 0x3 (FBNeo cheat database)

power_p2.note: super gauge of player 2 in %, full = 0x3 (FBNeo cheat database)

_p1_chr.note: player 1 character (FBNeo cheat database, Select 1st Character PL1)

_p2_chr.note: player 2 or computer character (FBNeo cheat database, Select 1st Character PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet

score_p2.note: player 2 score, found with learn.bat under RetroArch on a cabinet, 0x400 further like his health

_p1_ctl.note: player 1 controlled by a human (1) or the computer, found in RAM captures on a cabinet (a game on each side)

_p2_ctl.note: player 2 controlled by a human (1) or the computer, found in RAM captures on a cabinet (a game on each side)

_p1_hp1.note: player 1 health in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (1st Character) PL1)

_p1_hp2.note: player 1 health of his second fighter in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (2nd Character) PL1)

_p1_on1.note: player 1, fighter 1 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p1_on2.note: player 1, fighter 2 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p1_chr2.note: player 1, character of his second fighter, the first one +0x800

_p2_hp1.note: player 2 health in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (1st Character) PL2)

_p2_hp2.note: player 2 health of his second fighter in %, full = 0x90 (FBNeo cheat database, Infinite Energy (2nd Character) PL2)

_p2_on1.note: player 2, fighter 1 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p2_on2.note: player 2, fighter 2 on screen (1), found in RAM captures on a cabinet

_p2_chr2.note: player 2, character of his second fighter, the first one +0x800

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)

hd.note: HD themes of the fights (one per game, no stage value known), made by tools/cps_games.py
